from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
import ast, hashlib, json
out = Path('verification/A04')
fix = out / 'git-delivery-fix'
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
records = sorted(fix.glob('*-command.json'))
assert len(records) == 11
for path in records:
    d = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    start, end = [datetime.fromisoformat(d[k]) for k in ('startedUtc', 'endedUtc')]
    assert start.utcoffset().total_seconds() == end.utcoffset().total_seconds() == 0 and end >= start
    assert d['argv'] and d['cwd']
    for label in ('stdout', 'stderr'):
        p = fix / d[label + 'File']
        assert len(p.read_bytes()) == d[label + 'Bytes'] and sha(p) == d[label + 'Sha256']
for path in sorted(fix.glob('*-fingerprints.json')):
    d = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    assert d['before'] == d['after'] and d['byteReadonly'] and not d['runtimePresent']
assert len(list(fix.glob('*-fingerprints.json'))) == 8
for name, expected in [('candidate-delivery-manifest.json','0dc909dcd7abc42220f7d26e130211c7f6c0040527c1ddbce9d2bcc473c9a776'),('artifact-manifest.json','9158db0b688467526e37f4da8aeb46fbac559b046831e4825be9478b2ec1838c'),('input-bindings.json','61d53d9b3e75c05e73debacfcf3900c572cf63aeeef566ef01c21953c9bcfa32'),('独立精度复审报告.md','605d0e0fba19547aa165c0ef2096bf70e51b81a1ae41bf1e6407155d25c7bf48'),('精度测试报告.md','f4f3befa015981e31ab2e273695ed489adc4cae5af20da27dc4a3936fcf113a5')]:
    assert sha(out / name) == expected, name
assert sha(out / 'delivery_check.py') == '53ba1f8cf327b270b15816f77ebcf0c04bd2ef20ec252ff6645a646fdfdc7359'
assert sha(fix / 'history/delivery_check.py.before') == '380ea54ce4c86cecd6c304ebb6176de661c195161ac3209a1761d8a2553d9c24'
for p in (out / 'delivery_check.py', fix / 'test_git_delivery.py'):
    ast.parse(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
print(json.dumps(dict(passed=True, commands=11, rawStreams=22, readonlyTrees=8, protectedSnapshots=5, checkerSha256=sha(out / 'delivery_check.py'), scope='仅字节证据与语法；未执行数值计算'),ensure_ascii=False))
